Class SufsConstants

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.config.model.SufsConstants

  • public class SufsConstants
extends Object
    Constants data class containing SUFS constants. This class is populated from database data in the Constant class and is made available to executors and the user interface controllers in the ConstantsCache.
